title: Group 1 Pickleball Tournament Report
school: University of Santo Tomas, Institute of Physical Education and Athletics

committees.name: Tournament Management
committees.title: Tournament Director
duties: Ran the opening, the match clock and any delay decisions
Emceed the event and announced results
Handed the courts over to Group 2 at the end of our block

committees.name: Technical / Rules
committees.title: Rules marshal
duties: Moved between both courts and settled rule questions
Relieved a referee when they needed a break

committees.name: Officiating
committees.title: Referees and scorekeepers
duties: One referee and one scorekeeper on each court
Swapped jobs after Round 1 so each official did both
Called the score before every serve and filled in the score sheet

committees.name: Scheduling / Call desk
committees.title: Call desk
duties: Called the next two teams about 2 minutes before each match ended
Kept track of the clock between rounds

committees.name: Scoring / Tabulation
committees.title: Tabulators
duties: Collected the score sheets after each match
Updated the pool standings and recorded every result
Photographed the score sheets

committees.name: Equipment / Facilities
committees.title: Equipment crew
duties: Set up both courts, nets and the officials' area before the opening
Kept paddles and balls ready during play
Reset the courts at the end

committees.name: Safety / First Aid
committees.title: Safety officer
duties: Checked the courts before play
Watched for injuries during matches

committees.name: Documentation
committees.title: Documentation team
duties: Took photos and video of the tournament
Kept a log of problems during play
